Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 3166 . 1987 

Indian Standard 

REED SPACES FOR 
PLAIN CALICO LOOMS 



( First Revision ) 



0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard ( First Revision ) was adopted by the Bureau 
of Indian Standards on 25 June 1987, after the draft finalized by the 
Cotton Weaving Machinery Components Sectional Committee had been 
approved by the Textile Division Council. 

0.2 The standard originally published in 1965 has been revised to 
modify the definition of reed space to denote the overall width of reed 
which can be fixed on the loom. This will enable designation of loom 
by its *reed space' instead of 'working width'. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard prescribes a series of rationalized reed space of plain 
calico looms. 

2. TERMINOLOGY 

2.0 For the purpose of this standard, the following terms shall apply. 

2.1 Reed Space — Maximum space available on the loom for the 
insertion of a reed, that is, the overall width of reed which can be fixed 
on the loom ( see b in Fig. 1 ). 

2.2 Working Width — Working width is the maximum weavable 
width of warp in the reed which is normally 50 to 60 mm less than the 
reed space ( see a in Fig. 1 ). 

3. DESIGNATION ( OR CALL DIMENSION ) OF LOOM 

3.1 The loom shall be designated by its reed space. 

3 



IS : 3166 " 1987 

WARP SHEET 




Fig. 1 Reed Space and Working Width of Loom 



4. REED SPACE 

4.1 The reed space of the loom shall conform to any of the values in 
millimetres given below as agreed to between the buyer and the seller: 

800, 850, 900, 950, 1 000, 1 050, 1 200, 1 300, I 400, 1 450, 1 500, 

1 600, 1 700, 1 800, 2 000, 2 200, 2 300, 2 400, 2 500, 2600, 2 700, 

2 800, 2 900, 3 100, 3 300, 3 600.
